phases.caption: Close control at speed
phases.say: Close control at speed. The aim is to keep the ball inside the feet while changing direction, and to lift the head between touches. Four orange cones eight metres apart, a yellow gate at the top, and the queue behind the first cone. Every player brings their own ball and goes on the whistle.

phases.caption: Outside foot, round the first
phases.say: Seven, take it round the first cone with the outside of the foot. Small touches — the cone should never be more than a stride away.

phases.caption: Cut back across
phases.say: Now cut it back across your body for the second. Head up as you come out of the turn — that is the touch everyone forgets.

phases.caption: Third cone, then go
phases.say: Round the third and accelerate. Once you are past the last cone it is not a dribble any more, it is a run with the ball.

phases.caption: Through the yellow gate
phases.say: Through the yellow gate under control, stop the ball dead, and jog back down the side to rejoin the queue.

phases.caption:
Coaching points
- Touch every stride
- Outside foot going away
- Head up between touches
phases.say: Coaching points. A touch every stride, outside foot when you are going away from the cone, and get your head up between touches.
